title: Four game modes and a one-page set-up in the card style (design B, the deck)
problem: The Play page has six entries and the set-up is a scrolling pop-up; Quick Match is always two stalls.
scope: Four modes: Quick Match, Private Room, Computer, Pass & Play. Join with a code moves into Private Room; Public rooms into Quick Match
One-page set-up in design B (your shopkeeper card centred with neighbours peeking, seats as small cards, length, one big button) for Quick Match, Computer and Pass & Play
Private Room: the room page shows the code, the seats as cards and the length; shopkeepers are chosen after everyone has joined, on a pick screen in the same deck style
Quick Match chooses 2, 4 or 6 stalls; strangers are matched for up to 30 seconds and empty seats get Normal computers
exclusions: No rule or balance change; secret prices stay secret (leak check 0)

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e (0 leaks), including Quick Match at 4 stalls with two people and computers
Screens of each mode's set-up, the private room and the pick screen at 390x844, 360x640, 320x568: one page
The owner sees it on the preview

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-23: "game modes should be Quick Match (dont just limit to 1v1), Private Room, Computer, and Pass & Play" and "rework the attached screen (applicable to all game modes), it needs to be a one pager"; then, after three card-style mockups: "go with B, but remember for private room, characters are selected after everyone has joined, build the design as well"
